acceptance: Unit tests: unserved-provider probe failure gives healthy plus a notice; served-provider failure gives degraded; a one-run state change does not publish; the same change on two consecutive runs publishes once; recovery also needs two runs
After merge and monitor-install, review_gateway_host.sh check on the host reports no degraded line for antigravity-cli and #4282 closes on the next confirmed healthy transition
Docs describe the two-check rule and the served-provider scope
Decision gate: if served providers cannot be read from the existing check output, or the fix needs a credential, broker, client or launchd change, stop and ask the owner
context: Guardrails: work only in linked worktrees; never git add -A; Joe Harris identity, no agent trailers; no explanatory code/YAML comments (make comment-policy-check); no new CI skips, no required-check renames, no ruleset/settings/secret changes; no weakening of an existing check beyond the rule this item names; durable commit text without tracker ids. Do not change credentials, the broker, gateway clients or secrets. Host reinstall happens only after merge, from origin/develop.
description:
_project/scripts/review_gateway_host.sh check_usage_probes marks the whole gateway degraded when "omp auth-gateway check" fails for any broker login. Today it fails only for antigravity-cli (OAuth refresh 500), which the gateway does not serve; anthropic, openai-codex and google-antigravity are ok. cmd_monitor publishes on every state change, so brief failures opened and closed four issues (#4231, #4232, #4271, #4275) in two days.

Change: read the probe output per provider; a failure for a provider the gateway serves stays degraded, a failure for any other provider becomes a notice naming it. In cmd_monitor, publish (notify and issue) only when the same new signature is seen on two consecutive runs; keep a pending signature in the state directory. Keep the rule that an unfiled issue leaves the state unrecorded.

Scope: _project/scripts/review_gateway_host.sh, tests/unit/scripts/test_review_gateway_host.py, docs/internal/review-gateway-host.md.

review.reason: decided SHIP WITH FIXES with no Critical or High findings
